changelog: **Sales lead page hand-off (#3657 follow-up):** the "Hand over" button is offered only to whom `POST /api/sales/leads/[id]/handoff` lets through — the owner, the org's sales dispatcher or an admin with `relation.write` — decided on the server by `canHandOffLead()` / `actorMayHandOff()` (`src/lib/leadHandoff.ts`), the same check the hand-off itself now calls. A dispatcher under impersonation (who may read but not write) no longer sees a button the route would refuse.

en: The lead page shows "Hand over" only to people who are allowed to hand the lead over.
tr: Müşteri adayı sayfasındaki "Devret" düğmesi artık yalnızca adayı devretmeye yetkisi olanlara görünüyor.
de: Die Lead-Seite zeigt „Übergeben“ nur noch denen, die den Lead auch übergeben dürfen.
